value.rationale: The source explicitly relies on AC for its central generated-neighborhood equivalence and does not calibrate whether this is necessary. A single fixed depth-two term on extremely sparse height-three rooted partial orders already captures full choice; dropping to height two or modal depth one eliminates that requirement. This sharply determines the foundational boundary and is useful for applying bundled semantics in choice-free constructive investigations, independent of finite computation.
